name: svc.notify

parameters.query: SELECT id::text, telegram_chat_id, quiet_hours_start::text, quiet_hours_end::text, paused FROM users LIMIT 1;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Quiet Hours?').item.json.user_id, $('Quiet Hours?').item.json.scope || 'ad_hoc', $('Quiet Hours?').item.json.title || '', $('Quiet Hours?').item.json.body, $('Quiet Hours?').item.json.idempotency_key || null] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO notification_log (user_id, scope, title, body, channel, idempotency_key, queued_until)
VALUES ($1::uuid,$2,$3,$4,'telegram',$5,
        (CURRENT_DATE + (SELECT quiet_hours_end FROM users LIMIT 1))
          AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon'
        + CASE WHEN (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::time
                    >= (SELECT quiet_hours_end FROM users LIMIT 1)
               THEN INTERVAL '1 day' ELSE INTERVAL '0' END)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

notes: Outbound Telegram with quiet hours (22:00-08:00 Europe/Lisbon by default). priority:'high' bypasses both quiet hours and /pause. The queued_until arithmetic adds a day when the end time has already passed today, so a queued message never computes a send time in the past. Input: {body, title?, scope?, priority?, idempotency_key?}.
